findings.title: The current implementation handoff again contradicts the submitted worktrees
findings.evidence: Exact reconciliation of implementation.json repositories[].changed_files against `git status --porcelain -uall` found three real files absent as exact paths: backend `apps/api/test/catalog-inactive-terms.e2e-spec.ts`, backend `test/jest-e2e.json`, and frontend `apps/public-web/components/common/price.tsx`. The handoff substitutes strings suffixed with `(new, review-cycle-12)`, `(validation-fix attempt 3)`, and `(review-cycle-12)`, so they are annotations rather than valid inventory paths. The same handoff proposes documenting `fetchMatchingVariantsByProduct` as the current required price/preparation/rush convention even though that method was removed and the current code/summary correctly use bounded PostgreSQL aggregates. This regresses the handoff-integrity findings from reviews 006–008 and meets the vertical-slice skill gate requiring changes when handoff files do not match the diff/current cycle.
findings.expected_fix: Regenerate implementation.json from the exact current worktree inventory, keeping changed_files entries as bare real paths and moving annotations to the note/evidence fields. Replace or remove the obsolete `fetchMatchingVariantsByProduct` knowledge proposal so it describes the current bounded PostgreSQL DISTINCT-aggregate implementation. Reconcile the regenerated handoff against both worktrees and rerun the deterministic evidence-matrix check.

summary: Full seven-pass review completed across 78 backend and 41 frontend implementation files. The code, tests, current command results, architecture, security controls, and 34-entry UI-fidelity evidence satisfy all 20 technical acceptance criteria. Changes are requested because the required implementation handoff is not trustworthy: three changed-file entries are not real paths, and one proposed database rule documents a removed in-memory facet implementation. This is a repeated major evidence-integrity regression even though the runtime implementation itself is technically ready after the handoff is corrected.
